s: We manage Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) risks through governance and policy to safeguard data and minimize operational risk.
Governance and oversight is performed by a committee composed of senior management who oversee GenAI risks across cybersecurity, technology, and operational domains.

This group strives to ensure alignment with our broader risk management framework, which includes approving tools, applying cross-functional risk assessments to proposed use cases, responsible use, data protection, and awareness of GenAI limitations, including risks of inaccurate or biased outputs.
This committee and its members also provide updates on risk management activities and GenAI initiatives to Board Committees.
Under this approach, GenAI adoption supports operational efficiency while minimizing legal, security, financial, and reputational risks.
